children: its first-quarter and full-year fiscal 2027 financial guidance, with the financial technology company projecting revenue growth of 9% to 10% for the full year and 11% for the first quarter.
For fiscal 2027, Intuit expects total revenue of $23.27B to $23.51B (
: $23.41B). The company also reaffirmed its non-GAAP earnings outlook, with diluted EPS expected at $22.88 to $23.12 ($24.18 estimated), up 23% to 24% year over year.

For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Intuit expects revenue of $4.29B to $4.31B ($4.31B estimated), representing growth of 11%. Non-GAAP diluted EPS is projected at $2.44 to $2.48 ($2.72 estimated), implying growth of 30% to 33% from the year-ago quarter.
Intuit reaffirmed the guidance previously issued on Aug. 25, 2026, in conjunction with its Investor Day being held at the company's Mountain View, California, headquarters.

The company also maintained its full-year non-GAAP operating income guidance of $8.06B to $8.14B, representing growth of 17% to 18%. First-quarter non-GAAP operating income is expected at $902M to $915M, up 26% to 28%.

title: Intuit reaffirms fiscal 2027 guidance
